scripts.dev:staging: node --import tsx scripts/validate-environment.ts staging && APP_ENV=staging tsx server.ts

scripts.build:production: node --import tsx scripts/validate-environment.ts production && vite build --mode production && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs
